name: io.github.anthonywlicausi/agentic-ai
description: Deal intelligence for agents: free investor-match previews, SEC financials, deal scoring.

tools.name: investor_intro_preview
tools.description:
FREE, no API key. Use when someone wants to be connected with investors for a raise.
    Runs DEALITHIC's matching engine against 93,000+ funds, family offices and angels and returns how many fit and
    what kinds of investors they are (counts only: no firm names or contacts). asset_class is
    one of pe, vc, growth, credit, real_estate, infrastructure, preferred_equity, equity,
    public_equity, other. target_raise_m is the raise in USD millions. If the result looks
    useful, offer request_intro to book a demo where names and contacts are released.

asset_class.description: Type of capital being raised. vc = venture/startup equity, pe = private equity, growth = growth equity, credit = debt, equity = general equity.
asset_class.title: Asset Class

target_raise_m.description: Amount being raised in USD millions, e.g. 5 for $5M.
target_raise_m.title: Target Raise M

industry.description: The company's sector in plain words, e.g. 'software', 'healthcare', 'fintech', 'industrial'.
industry.title: Industry

geography.description: Optional. Where the company is based, e.g. 'United States'.
geography.title: Geography

ebitda_m.description: Optional. Annual EBITDA in USD millions, if the company has earnings.
ebitda_m.title: Ebitda M

tools.name: lp_match_preview
tools.description:
FREE, no API key. Use when a fund manager (GP) wants to find LPs for a fund they are raising.
    Returns how many LP-type investors in DEALITHIC's network fit each LP type (pension,
    endowment, foundation, sovereign_wealth, fund_of_funds, family_office): counts only, no
    names or contacts. Counts are by LP type and are not yet scored against the strategy or
    fund size. target_fund_size_m is in USD millions. lp_types optionally narrows the types.
    If useful, offer request_lp_intro to book a demo where specific LPs are released.

fund_strategy.description: The fund's strategy in plain words, e.g. 'venture capital', 'real estate', 'private credit'.
fund_strategy.title: Fund Strategy

target_fund_size_m.description: Target fund size in USD millions, e.g. 100 for $100M.
target_fund_size_m.title: Target Fund Size M

lp_types.description: Optional. Narrow to some LP types: pension, endowment, foundation, sovereign_wealth, fund_of_funds, family_office. Omit for all.
lp_types.title: Lp Types

tools.name: request_lp_intro
tools.description:
FREE, no API key. Records a fund manager's request to be introduced to DEALITHIC and
    booked into a demo about raising their fund from LPs. Only call this after the person has
    explicitly agreed to be contacted by email, and set consent=true only in that case.

firm.description: Name of the fund manager's firm.
firm.title: Firm

fund_summary.description: Two or three sentences on the fund being raised: strategy, size, stage.
fund_summary.title: Fund Summary

consent.description: True only if the person explicitly agreed to be contacted by email. Never assume.
consent.title: Consent

tools.name: request_intro
tools.description:
FREE, no API key. Records a request to be introduced to DEALITHIC and booked into a demo,
    where matched investors are revealed. Only call this after the person has explicitly agreed
    to be contacted by email about their raise, and set consent=true only in that case.

company.description: Name of the company raising capital.
company.title: Company

deal_summary.description: Two or three sentences on the raise: amount, sector, stage, use of funds.
deal_summary.title: Deal Summary

consent.description: True only if the person explicitly agreed to be contacted by email. Never assume.
consent.title: Consent

tools.name: sec_extract
tools.description:
Use when you need trustworthy financial statements for a US public company and want to
    cite the source. Verified financial statements and derived metrics for a US-listed ticker,
    extracted from SEC EDGAR XBRL filings. Every value carries provenance (the
    exact filing, form, and tag it came from); missing facts are null, never 0.
    $0.25/call after free trial.

ticker.description: US stock ticker symbol, e.g. 'AAPL'. Must be an SEC-registered, US-listed company.
ticker.title: Ticker

tools.name: validate_financials
tools.description:
Use before relying on a company's financials or projections, to catch errors and
    unrealistic assumptions. Institutional validation pass over company financials: tax-rate sanity,
    EBITDA/EBIT bridge, growth continuity vs historical CAGR, capex ratio,
    working-capital stability. Returns integrity score + severity-ranked flags.
    $0.50/call after free trial.

financials.description: Company financials as a JSON object. Uses 'historical_financials' and 'projections', each holding yearly lists such as income_statement (revenue, ebitda, ebit, income_before_tax, income_taxes), balance_sheet (net_working_capital) and capex. Missing years or fields are skipped, not guessed.
financials.title: Financials

tools.name: company_report
tools.description:
Use when someone wants a full, cited analysis of a US-listed company rather than raw numbers.
    The flagship: eight-lens institutional analysis of a US-listed company, grounded
    entirely in SEC-verified figures with per-field filing citations. Lenses: equity
    research, investment banking, strategy consulting, turnaround ops, comparables,
    capital markets, disclosure audit, and Charlie Munger's 10 mental models — plus an
    executive synthesis. Optionally pass `market` (e.g. {"price": 12.34,
    "market_cap_m": 5000}) from your own data source to enable valuation views, and
    `context` — your own deal materials (CIM extracts, computed valuations), treated as
    caller-asserted rather than SEC-verified. $25.00/call after free trial; allow ~60s.

ticker.description: US stock ticker symbol, e.g. 'AAPL'. Must be an SEC-registered, US-listed company.
ticker.title: Ticker

market.description: Optional. Your own market data to enable valuation views, e.g. {"price": 12.34, "market_cap_m": 5000}.
market.title: Market

context.description: Optional. Your own deal materials as text (CIM extracts, computed valuations). Treated as caller-asserted, not SEC-verified.
context.title: Context

tools.name: deal_score
tools.description:
Use when someone wants a private deal or company scored and stress-tested for investors.
    Full underwriting chain on a deal profile: financial integrity → trend →
    industry position → stress tests → conviction score, plus a risk register and
    investment thesis (and an rNPV valuation band for biotech deals with
    `indications`). $2.00/call after free trial.

deal.description: Deal profile as a JSON object: the company, its industry, historical financials and projections (same shape as validate_financials input). Biotech deals may add an 'indications' list to get an rNPV valuation band.
deal.title: Deal
